stories.summary: OpenAI’s MedChemBench evaluates models on 99 medicinal-chemistry problems drawn from 117 papers and patents, covering 761 chemical structures. GPT-6.2 Astra scored 84.5%, while harder numerical property-prediction and selection questions remained weaker. The benchmark exposes source material, scoring rules and task structure so teams can inspect where apparent scientific competence breaks down.

stories.headline: Harness adapters improve one coding agent without proving transfer

source.title: Harness adapters at scale
source.scope: Reviewed the complete experiment, including Qwen3.8-27B, harness-specific LoRA training, 858 validated tasks, 171 qualified tasks, Pi score and token changes, AutomationBench out-of-distribution results and the authors’ reasoning-leakage limitation.
source.freshness_reason: Published on the current research date; the original source was fully reviewed.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete experiment, including Qwen3.8-27B, harness-specific LoRA training, 858 validated tasks, 171 qualified tasks, Pi score and token changes, AutomationBench out-of-distribution results and the authors’ reasoning-leakage limitation.

stories.summary: Hugging Face trained a separate LoRA adapter for each coding-agent harness using Qwen3.8-27B. The Pi adapter raised the reported score from 39% to 55% while cutting average tokens from 2,900 to 1,500. Out-of-distribution AutomationBench results stayed near the base model, leaving transfer beyond the trained harness unresolved.
stories.why_it_matters: Agent teams can test whether behavior belongs to the model or its surrounding harness. Hold the base model constant, train against one interface, measure token use and then run a separate task distribution before claiming a reusable capability gain.
stories.image_alt_intent: One base coding model branches into harness-specific adapters, with Pi performance and token-use gains on one side and a flat out-of-distribution transfer test on the other.

stories.summary: Databricks tested 125 questions three times in a fictional insurance setting. Raw tables answered 64% correctly; curated agents and a governed semantic layer each reached 83%, while combining them reached 95%. Separate tests showed definitions and documents resolved different failures, and a 12-question change test checked whether updated policies propagated.
stories.why_it_matters: Teams can distinguish prompt curation from governed business context. Build a representative question set, isolate definitions, documents and table access, repeat runs and test a policy change before assuming that adding more instructions will make an agent reliable.

stories.summary: Google Research explains how Duplex evolved into Tasks in Gemini, which can call businesses on a user’s behalf. read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete updated guide covering Accounting plugin installation, authorized sources, company and period rules, reconciliation, invoice entry, reporting, audit support, record citations, uncertainty flags, duplicate checks, review and saving a recurring workflow as a Skill.

stories.summary: OpenAI’s accounting guide shows how to connect authorized records, specify company, period and accounting rules, then run reconciliation, invoice-entry, reporting and audit-support workflows. It recommends record citations, uncertainty flags, duplicate checks and human review. A stable recurring procedure can then be saved as a Skill without removing professional judgment.
stories.why_it_matters: Accountants can turn one repeated reconciliation into a reusable, bounded Skill. Define permitted sources, period and rules; require cited records, duplicate detection and uncertainty flags; test exceptions on a known sample; then keep final posting and sign-off with an authorized reviewer.
stories.image_alt_intent: An accounting reconciliation Skill connects authorized records to cited matches, duplicate and uncertainty flags, an exception sample and a final authorized sign-off.

audience_fit.intended_user: Accountants and finance staff who repeat reconciliations across authorized records and need an inspectable review trail.
audience_fit.practical_action: Define the permitted sources, period and accounting rules, then require citations, duplicate checks and uncertainty flags on every run.
audience_fit.review_action: Test known matches and exceptions, inspect every cited record and keep posting authority with an authorized reviewer.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A reusable reconciliation procedure that produces cited proposed matches and explicit exceptions without automatically posting entries.

stories.agent_skills_evidence: The source documents a reusable accounting procedure: constrain permitted records and period, require cited matches, detect duplicates, flag uncertainty, test known exceptions and reserve posting authority for an authorized reviewer. Substantive current security work, but MedChemBench supplied a distinct inspectable benchmark with stronger scientific evaluation value for this lane.

fallback_decisions.why_selected_over_recent_options: MedChemBench provides chemist-reviewed pharmaceutical tasks, category-level results and reproducible benchmark files; the other current candidates concern security defenses or consumer errands rather than scientific decision evaluation.

The harness study isolates adapter instructions while holding the base model and benchmark constant, a specific engineering comparison absent from the newer security release and consumer workflow announcement.

The Microsoft feedback loop uniquely converts reviewer annotations into golden datasets and task rubrics; the newer security and connected-apps sources address different mechanisms and cannot replace this applied quality-control decision.

The Databricks experiment supplies controlled context ablations, repeated questions and a policy-change test; the newer sources do not answer how governed definitions and documents change business-agent accuracy.

The Duplex operating history documents disclosure, task boundaries and transfer behavior for autonomous phone calls; the newer connected-apps note is fresher but does not provide comparable deployed calling controls.
The accounting guide supports the edition’s sole reusable noncoding Skill with cited records, duplicate checks and sign-off; newer candidates lacked this distinct procedure and reader outcome.

programs.source_scope: Reviewed the exact 6:33 Journal Editorial Report interview in which Paul Gigot and Holman Jenkins discuss Nvidia leadership, AI-chip production and national-security implications.
programs.reader_question: Use the interview as a scenario prompt, not a forecast: identify leadership concentration, manufacturing dependencies and government exposure, then name the evidence and contingency trigger that would change your operational plan.
programs.distinct_contribution: This program addresses ai chip leadership scenario, a separate reader decision from the other selected media programs.

programs.source_scope: Reviewed the exact CBS Mornings feature and companion description of David Fajgenbaum’s Castleman disease experience, successful drug repurposing and bounded proposal to use AI for other rare-disease candidates.
programs.reader_question: Use the feature to frame AI drug repurposing as candidate generation, not medical proof. Require traceable literature, disease-specific expertise, safety review and prospective clinical evidence before moving a suggested existing drug toward patient care.
programs.distinct_contribution: This program addresses rare disease repurposing, a separate reader decision from the other selected media programs.

programs.source_scope: Reviewed the complete dated transcript and exact 18:04 runtime, including model releases, task completion cost, tool friction and the primary sources cited by the host.
programs.reader_question: Use the episode to build a task-level comparison: define completion, record retries and tool friction, then compare total cost and review time across two models. Keep vendor benchmark claims separate from your own observed work.
programs.distinct_contribution: This program addresses model completion cost, a separate reader decision from the other selected media programs.

programs.source_scope: Reviewed the complete 4:46 publisher transcript, exact episode identity and production disclosure covering accounting connectors, permissions, write-back risk and human approval.
programs.reader_question: Use the episode to inventory every connector before enabling an accounting agent. Separate read, draft and write permissions; identify who approves changes; log source records and revoke access that is broader than the workflow requires.
programs.distinct_contribution: This program addresses accounting permissions, a separate reader decision from the other selected media programs.
